name: mdrfc
description: Simple markdown viewer — terminal + web. RFC-style monospace, 72-col width.

scripts.build: bun build --compile src/main.ts --outfile mdrfc && node scripts/postbuild.mjs mdrfc
scripts.build:macos-arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile mdrfc-darwin-arm64 && node scripts/postbuild.mjs mdrfc-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:macos-x64: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/main.ts --outfile mdrfc-darwin-x64 && node scripts/postbuild.mjs mdrfc-darwin-x64
